Population.evidence_source: young men who lost a friend to suicide provided rich data and unique insights into the nature of their social and interpersonal interaction with the deceased, and the ways in which they interpreted and responded to events preceding the suicide.

Type.evidence_source: Using systematic research methods to gather the stories and experiences of young men who lost a friend to suicide provided rich data and unique insights into the nature of their social and interpersonal interaction with the deceased, and the ways in which they interpreted and responded to events preceding the suicide.
